leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom React hook to manage state synchronized with localStorage
Initialize state within the hook using a value retrieved from localStorage
Construct an effect to persist state changes to localStorage automatically
Apply the custom hook in a functional component to manage user input
Manipulate stored data by updating state through the hook's returned setter function
Configure the hook to handle JSON serialization and parsing for complex data types
Integrate the hook with input elements to create a persistent form or settings panel
